items.claim: Registers: 255 per thread, 256 KB register file per SM
items.verdict: verified (Programming Guide compute capabilities: 64K 32-bit registers per SM, 255 per thread)

items.claim: RTX 5090: up to 128 KB unified L1/shared per SM, ~100 KB usable as shared
items.verdict: verified (CC 12.0: 128 KB unified, 100 KB shared, 99 per block)

items.claim: L2 96 MB on GB202 vs 72 MB on 4090-class
items.verdict: verified (RTX Blackwell whitepaper: 96 MB on RTX 5090, 72 MB on 4090); 96 MB carried, 4090 left to GPU architecture
verified (1,792 GB/s); capacity left to Topic: hardware

items.claim: Latency ballparks ~1, ~20-30, ~200, ~400-800 cycles
items.verdict: corrected by the parent (Luo et al. H800: shared 29.0, L1 40.7, L2 263.0, global 478.8); quoted, not repeated

items.claim: Host RAM over PCIe ~64 GB/s, microseconds
items.verdict: left to Interconnects and scaling (linked); BPG's dated PCIe Gen3 ~12 GB/s pinned example quoted

items.claim: Spilling: values pushed to local memory, which lives in HBM/L2; check ptxas -v or Nsight
items.verdict: verified and extended: register-cap sweep compiled for 3 targets; local memory without pressure (run-time indexed array) compiled and measured

items.claim: Shared memory is an explicit scratchpad, static or dynamic via the third launch parameter, carved from the same SRAM as L1, paired with __syncthreads()
items.verdict: verified (Programming Guide); compiled static/dynamic declarations; 48 KB opt-in and carveout added

items.claim: A warp's loads are serviced as 32-128 byte transactions
items.verdict: corrected: 32-byte transactions (sectors), Programming Guide 2.3.4.1

items.claim: Strided or scattered access cuts effective bandwidth by 10-30x
items.verdict: unconfirmed as a general range; the parent measured 6.0x at stride 32 on the M1; this page measured AoS field reads 3.6x slower than SoA

items.claim: threadIdx.x should index the contiguous dimension
items.verdict: verified

items.claim: Boehm: coalescing took the naive kernel from ~300 to ~2000 GFLOP/s on an A6000
items.verdict: verified by the parent (309 to 1,986.5); not repeated

items.claim: float4 128-bit loads improve bandwidth and cut instructions; need 16-byte alignment
items.verdict: verified (NVIDIA CUDA Pro Tip, compiled LDG.E.128); refined: no bandwidth gain on a plain M1 copy (measured), the gain is instructions and bytes in flight

items.claim: Structure-of-arrays beats array-of-structures
items.verdict: verified and measured (M1: 3.66 vs 1.03 ms)

items.claim: Shared memory: 32 banks, 4 bytes wide; broadcast; k-way serialisation
items.verdict: verified (Programming Guide 2.3.4.2)
